entries.intent: Every non-exact answer is judged by models only through one ordered chain: Jev (typesafe/jev-1.14), then the fallback decisions models in order on unavailable/error/unparseable, then one escalation LLM (google/gemini-4-hydrogen) as soon as a decisions model is uncertain or none answers; one judgment reservation sized for the costliest path; each attempt logged without the answer or a key.

entries.note: Headed run forces, per submission, primary / primary-unavailable / -error / -unparseable / chain-unavailable / primary-low-confidence / -low-probability / -thin-margin / primary-none / all-fail via SCRY_TEST_JUDGE_PATHS; the server's own "judge chain" log line proves the models asked (attempt count, escalation, no secondary decisions model after an uncertain primary). The every-path-fails submission is answered 503 with the full Study page and the kept answer (the page script takes its failure path on a non-2xx); it is the one expected 5xx of the run, listed under forcedFailures. Real OpenRouter/Typesafe adapters are proved against local httptest stand-ins only: no live model was called (no spend). Fallback/escalation model prices are documented estimates (NOTES.md) because the catalog was not read without network.

entries.source: PRODUCT.md :: [S113-2]; DESIGN.md :: Motion, Waits errors and recovery, Color (controls), Voice answer, Card and billing forms
entries.intent: Every wait says its word beside its control (checking / still checking, listening / transcribing, saving, snoozing, removing, importing + progress line, preparing) with the control disabled and busy; every failure says what happened, keeps the input and retries in place; every transition is 120–240 ms ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1)) with no overshoot; under reduced motion nothing moves, pulses or loops.

entries.note: verify-slice113-results.json "motionObserved" lists every animation/transition sampled each frame in the real browser (64+ distinct per config), with declared and live durations and easings. A reversed (interrupted) transition runs shortened by the CSS reversing-shortening factor; its declared duration is what is judged. Edit card drawer motion needs ::details-content / interpolate-size (current Chrome); older browsers open it at once.
